label: General
tooltip: FATEs, Critical Encounters, pots, mounting, BOCCHI AI, Triage Mode, Return, and repair.

prefer_pot_fates.label: Prefer pot FATEs
prefer_pot_fates.tooltip: Always do Magic Pot FATEs. When on, priority is pot → Critical Encounter → other FATEs. When off, it is Critical Encounter → pot → other FATEs. On the FATEs tab they stay checked and say “required” until you turn this off.

should_farm_pot_chests.label: Farm pot chests after pot FATEs
should_farm_pot_chests.tooltip: After a pot FATE, drink Magical Elixir and follow the compass while Cache Me If You Can lasts. No compass hint? It walks known chest spots instead.

should_preposition_to_pots.label: Wait near pots before they spawn
should_preposition_to_pots.tooltip: Leave early and stand near where the next pot FATE should appear. Timing is under Pot timing. Needs "Do FATEs" on, and that pot FATE allowed under Allowed FATEs (or "Prefer pot FATEs" on).

should_do_critical_encounters.label: Do Critical Encounters
should_do_critical_encounters.tooltip: Go to and complete Critical Encounters.

leave_fate_travel_for_ce_seconds.label: Leave FATE travel for a CE when (seconds left)
leave_fate_travel_for_ce_seconds.tooltip: While walking to a FATE, only switch to a Critical Encounter when its registration has this many seconds or fewer left. 0 = switch as soon as a CE is up. Once you are in the FATE or already fighting it, it still finishes first.

combat_autorotation.label: Combat autorotation
combat_autorotation.tooltip: Which autorotation to use in FATEs, CEs, and Mob Farmer fights. Off while traveling or pulling. None = you fight.

update_boss_mod_presets_automatically.label: Update presets automatically
update_boss_mod_presets_automatically.tooltip: When on, Illegal Mode rebuilds BOCCHI AI FATE / BOCCHI AI CE (or the AR pair) from the stock presets when it starts and when you change job or melee/ranged. When off, existing presets are kept and only created if missing.
update_boss_mod_presets_automatically.button_tooltip: Replace BOCCHI AI FATE and BOCCHI AI CE (or the AR pair) with the stock presets. Edits you made in BossMod are overwritten.

max_distance_by_role.label: Set max distance to target based on role
max_distance_by_role.tooltip: Melee uses the melee distance (or stay on hitbox). Ranged, caster, and healer use the ranged distance.

melee_on_hitbox.label: Melee stay on hitbox
melee_on_hitbox.tooltip: Melee jobs stand on the edge of the target hitbox. Turn off to set a distance in yalms instead.

max_distance.label: Max distance to target
max_distance.tooltip: How far BOCCHI AI tries to stay from the target, in yalms past the hitbox.

max_distance_melee.label: Max distance to target | Melee
max_distance_melee.tooltip: Melee distance in yalms past the hitbox. Ignored while Melee stay on hitbox is on.

max_distance_ranged.label: Max distance to target | Ranged
max_distance_ranged.tooltip: Ranged, caster, and healer distance in yalms past the hitbox.

overdodge.label: Overdodge
overdodge.tooltip: Extra space BossMod keeps from dangerous areas while pathfinding.

delay.label: Delay movement
delay.tooltip: Wait this long before BOCCHI AI starts moving. Keep this low or you can get hit.

stay_mounted_while_waiting_for_ce.label: Stay mounted while waiting for CEs
stay_mounted_while_waiting_for_ce.tooltip: Stay on your mount after you arrive at a CE that is still preparing.

stop_after_return.label: Stop after return and teleport
stop_after_return.tooltip: After a FATE or CE, Return, teleport toward the next one, mount, then stop. Toggle Illegal Mode to resume.

phantom_jobs_leveling_mode.label: Level phantom jobs automatically
phantom_jobs_leveling_mode.tooltip: When your phantom job is maxed, switch to the next unlocked one that is not. Skips Freelancer.

enable_triage_mode.label: Triage Mode
enable_triage_mode.tooltip: After a FATE or CE, raise nearby dead players with your chosen phantom job, then continue. Skips anyone who already has a raise.

preferred_triage_raise_job.label: Triage raise job
preferred_triage_raise_job.tooltip: Which phantom job to use for raises.

should_cast_treasure_sight.label: Cast Treasure Sight at camp
should_cast_treasure_sight.tooltip: At camp, cast Treasure Sight on a timer.

treasure_sight_recast_interval_seconds.label: Treasure Sight every (seconds)
treasure_sight_recast_interval_seconds.tooltip: How often to cast Treasure Sight at camp.

max_remote_idle_time_seconds.label: Max wait before Return (seconds)
max_remote_idle_time_seconds.tooltip: After a FATE or CE, wait a random time between 2 seconds and this before Return. Skipped when a Treasure Sight survey is queued — that Returns straight away so Sight lands before the next activity.

max_base_teleport_delay_seconds.label: Max wait before leaving camp (seconds)
max_base_teleport_delay_seconds.tooltip: At camp, wait 0 to this many seconds before leaving for a FATE or CE. 0 = leave right away.

auto_repair_threshold.label: Repair gear below (%)
auto_repair_threshold.tooltip: At base camp, repair any equipped piece at or below this durability.

enable_automatic_treasure_hunt_during_il.label: Auto treasure hunt in Illegal Mode
enable_automatic_treasure_hunt_during_il.tooltip: After a FATE or CE, Return to camp, cast Treasure Sight if you know it, then hunt remaining coffers.
